responsibility: Provides ARM’s common target-hook implementation for option canonicalization, unwind-model selection, and assembler-facing rewriting of architecture/CPU/FPU choices. Beyond setting ARM optimization defaults and default target flags, it decides whether exceptions use SJLJ, DWARF2, or ARM EABI unwind tables, rewrites -mcpu/-march strings into forms accepted by assemblers, canonicalizes architecture extension lists, derives BE8 linker options, and synthesizes an explicit -mfpu= value from the selected ISA so later ARM backend stages operate on normalized architecture and floating-point feature descriptions.
